references.text: The contrast between Lot as a travel companion in God's call and Lot as a captive in God's judgment underscores the consequence of his choice to live in Sodom.
13:12 explains the reason for Lot's captivity in 14:12 by showing his deliberate choice to live in Sodom.
The contrast between Abraham's active movement toward Sodom and Lot's passive removal from the city highlights Abraham's role as a rescuer.
